title: Aliases and back-links for agents/agent-sandboxes (Docker Sandboxes sbx, gVisor runsc)
goal: _tools/aliases.csv holds the rows 'sbx,docker sandboxes', 'docker sandboxes,docker sandboxes', 'runsc,gvisor' and 'gvisor,gvisor', and the Reference sections of kb/public/claude/agent-sdk.md and kb/public/windows/windows-sandbox.md name agents/agent-sandboxes.md

run: import csv,pathlib,sys; r={tuple(x) for x in csv.reader(open('_tools/aliases.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}; w={('sbx','docker sandboxes'),('docker sandboxes','docker sandboxes'),('runsc','gvisor'),('gvisor','gvisor')}; l=all('agents/agent-sandboxes.md' in pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in ('kb/public/claude/agent-sdk.md','kb/public/windows/windows-sandbox.md')); sys.exit(0 if w<=r and l else 1)
